intro: Across 11 articles published between 12 April and 11 October 2026, ZCyberNews tracked industrial control system security against a severity mix of two critical, seven high, and one medium finding. CVE-2026-105278 carries a CVSS score of 9.8, while CVE-2026-5726 rates 7.8. Reporting on these ICS issues centred on the energy, manufacturing, critical-infrastructure, critical infrastructure, and industrial sectors. Coverage spanned Global, United states, and North-america, reflecting the reach of exposed control environments across regions and industries throughout the period.
